free_tier.stated: 5 GB object storage per project + 1 GB Postgres per project (20 GB account total); 100 projects on Free

egress.terms: 5 GB/month public network transfer per project, shared across Postgres, object storage and functions; then $0.10/GB on paid only — Free is a hard 5 GB.

tooling: Real S3 API (`forcePathStyle: true`, path-style only), AWS SDK/boto3/aws CLI, `neon buckets` CLI, files-sdk.dev `neon` adapter. Endpoint is per-branch: https://br-<name>.storage.<cell>.<region>.aws.neon.tech
chaining: 100 projects/org (Free) x 5 GB object storage = 500 GB; x 20 GB Postgres cap = only 20 GB of DB storage, but object storage is NOT under that 20 GB cap — it is per project. Add branches: 10 branches/project, objects branch without copying. Multiple orgs per account are allowed ('one Neon account can belong to multiple orgs on different plans').
limits_note: Max object size 5 GiB; throttling returns 503 SlowDown under load; path-style only, no virtual-host buckets; ACL/policy must be set via Console/API, not S3 wire. 5 GB egress/project/month is the real wall for serving.
